summary: Where geometry meets craftsmanship, Shard X redefines the architectural basin. Refined, deliberate, and beautifully proportioned, it embodies expressive minimalism with enduring presence.
title: Design Excellence For Small Bathrooms – Shard X
bodyHtml:
New Shard X 50 Bench in Gloss Pink - 500 x 350 x 140 mm

Geometry as a Design Language

The Shard X series represents a study in proportion and precision — where geometry becomes both structure and statement.

 

Defined by crisp lines and architectural rhythm, Shard X brings sculptural clarity to contemporary bathrooms, melding expressive minimalism with superior strength and quality.

 

Perfect for Powder Rooms - Shard X 35 Bench - 350 x 350 x 140 mm

Proportion Meets Possibility

Now offered in shorter projections, Shard X extends its bold design language to compact spaces.

This adaptation allows the collection to retain its striking visual presence while accommodating smaller bathrooms and powder rooms — a testament to Italian design’s ability to balance beauty with function.

 

Shard X 70 Bench in Gloss White - 700 x 350 x 140 mm

A Refined Expression of Italian Design

Each piece in the Shard X series is meticulously crafted and hand-finished in Italy by Olympia Ceramica, exemplifying the integrity and artistry synonymous with Studio Bagno’s portfolio.

Available in a range of matte and gloss finishes, Shard X integrates effortlessly within diverse material schemes — from raw concrete to warm timber and natural stone.
